The performing orchestral edition is not identified. The song, No. 2, dates from 1897; the source collection’s blanket 1882 date belongs to No. 1.

Internet Archive dates this pressing 1923; DAHR dates the Victor 6058 issue [1922]. Both precede the 1925 publication cutoff. The session was in 1921, not 1923. IA’s “6058B” matrix field is the issue side number, not the Gramophone matrix.

Processing
Transferred at 78 rpm. The preferred named FLAC uses a 3.3 mil truncated-conical stylus; turnover 0, rolloff 0; the streamed MP3 derives from that FLAC. Documented

Surface noise and transfer equalisation prevent absolute sound-quality or loudness comparisons.

[1]
Composition rights
Underlying song and Pushkin text are public domain under ordinary life-plus-70 terms Inferred, not documented

Rimsky-⁠Korsakov died in 1908 and Pushkin in 1837; the song was published in 1898. No rights in an unidentified modern edition are asserted.

[4] [2]
Recording rights
US public domain: sound recording published before the 1925 cutoff Documented

Internet Archive dates this pressing 1923; DAHR dates the Victor 6058 issue [1922]. Both precede the 1925 publication cutoff. The session was in 1921, not 1923. IA’s “6058B” matrix field is the issue side number, not the Gramophone matrix. No non-commercial licence is present in the inspected archive metadata.
